Relay Rev D mounts outside the battery footprint on the outboard/access edge with about 80 mm relay-to-battery service gap, using a flat 360 x 245 x 3 mm aluminium base mounted vertically and directly flat to the main metal service sheet plus exact 300 x 197 insulating sheet and the existing covered relay box; no separate relay cable-boot, output-cluster, or loom-card fabrication is added above it. The red relay power pipe enters the relay top hole closest to the battery, and the relay output power bundle leaves the second top relay hole. MIDI Rev D hinged enclosure mounts on a separated shallow top-front shelf whose leading edge starts at the battery leading-edge datum, with fuse 4 cutoff-switched power input through the input/bus-side grommet, five output-side grommets, and the far-side output enlarged for two power cables. Folded cutoff/kill-switch base/guard sits beside the MIDI enclosure, not after the MIDI outputs, with a 210 x 150 mm flat pattern, 170 x 110 mm finished face, and 20 mm lips bent upward around the 100A breaker/terminal side. Central battery positive enters the far-side cutoff/kill-switch stud first; the near-side cutoff output splits into two protected branches, one to the red relay power pipe and one to the MIDI fuse 4 grommeted input, with an 80 mm cable gutter and five-output fanout clearance.
